blind.description: A vertical stack of three traditional wooden coffins/caskets, each with a hexagonal coffin shape wider at the shoulders and tapering toward the head and foot. The coffins are neatly stacked on top of each other, each with a planked wooden lid and framed body. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized in a clean hand-painted or low-poly wood texture with warm brown tones. Sits flat directly on the floor with no plinth.
blind.from_above: Shows the top coffin's lid with stylized longitudinal wooden planks arranged in a classic hexagonal coffin contour, slightly revealing the edges of the lower coffins underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 feet tall), with a length of roughly 5 to 6 feet and width around 2 to 2.5 feet.
